issue_request: FHIR-19733 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core terminology issue raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that v2 table 0550 had an invalid whitespace code with display External Jugular and another garbled Unicode-looking code, apparently from an import problem.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-19733-tagged source commit was found. The old core source/v2 table source already had code JUGE for Jugular, External before commit 5c0494a removed source/v2 and the v2/v3 importers from the core build. Commit 02557a9 later reintroduced a tools/tx/v2/source.xml tooling copy with the same JUGE entry, but that copy is not an active current core build input.
additional_context: Current core terminology guidance points unlisted code-system authority to THO, UTG CI, and TSMG. Zulip discussion confirms the original issue was treated as an import/source problem and the 2025 remaining table 0550 THO errors were routed through UTG. UP-681 is the implemented UTG proposal that removed the erroneous whitespace and garbled table 0550 codes. FHIR-20386 is the broader same-family FHIR-core issue already audited on the combined branch as external-repo.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current FHIR core does not build v2 table 0550 from source/v2 or tools/tx/v2, the local tooling copy already has JUGE rather than whitespace for External Jugular, and the authoritative THO/UTG table 0550 source has been corrected externally.
